itu.name: ITU ICT Price Baskets, December 2025 release
itu.method: Retail basket prices collected under ITU rules; country prices are published in USD and as a share of monthly GNI per capita. Basket definitions changed in 2025.

itu-detail.name: ITU 2025 basket allowances and operator metadata
itu-detail.method: Selected plans and allowances may exceed the minimum basket requirement. These are 2025 observations, not live retail quotes.

ipsos.name: Google / Ipsos Our Life With AI, 2025 fieldwork
ipsos.method: Online non-probability survey, approximately 1,000 adults per country; fieldwork 22 September–10 October 2025. Self-reported use. Results describe the surveyed sample and must not be presented as a census of all residents.

microsoft.name: Microsoft AI Economy Institute, Global AI Adoption in 2025
microsoft.method: Generative-AI diffusion estimate adjusted from Microsoft telemetry for device/OS market share, internet penetration and population. Working-age denominator; not a direct population survey or a measure of workplace adoption. Appendix pp. 15–17.

pnet.name: Pnet Job Market Trends, August 2025
pnet.method: Change in AI-related vacancies observed by Pnet. A vacancy is an advertisement, not a hire or net job creation. The report includes international and remote listings; it is not a census of domestic employment.

pwc.name: PwC Africa Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey 2025
pwc.method: Pooled employee survey covering Algeria, Kenya, Morocco, Nigeria and South Africa. Not an Africa-wide population estimate and not assignable to individual countries. Survey programme reports 1,753 responses across the five countries.

aws.name: AWS EC2 instance types by Region
aws.method: Regional product listing checked on the review date. It does not establish spare capacity, granted account quotas, actual uptime or an available rental price.

cassava.name: Cassava AI, South Africa deployment update
cassava.method: Operator-reported South Africa deployment and GPU service offering. Expansion countries are plans, not operating sites verified by this review.

cassava-product.name: Cassava AI GPU as a Service
cassava-product.method: Advertises H200 GPU services and on-demand, reserved and spot options. No numerical rental rate or installed GPU total found on the reviewed page.

teraco.name: Teraco JB4 expansion completion
teraco.method: Operator reports completion of a 30 MW addition, bringing the JB4 campus to 50 MW critical IT capacity. Total and increment must not be added. Rated capacity is not actual electricity consumption or AI-specific compute.

kenya-study.name: Columbia Business School research summary: Kenyan entrepreneur experiment
kenya-study.method: Study of 640 Kenyan entrepreneurs. Business performance evidence, not a national employment or wage estimate. Summary reports no statistically significant average effect; this does not mean an effect of exactly zero.

uct-study.name: University of Cape Town: AI career-guidance research grant
uct-study.method: Research announcement. No completed employment-impact estimate is extracted from this source.
